description: This file defines the EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver class which implements the IEventHubReceiver interface. It is responsible for receiving event data from an event hub using a data generator, with methods to receive, stop, configure, and close the receiver.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver
classes.description: A receiver class that fetches event data from an event hub using a data generator, with configurability and control over data generation per stream.

methods.name: EventHubPartitionGeneratorReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with a data generator.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously receives event data, simulating real-life delay and using the generator to produce events.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production on a specified stream if the generator supports it.

methods.name: ConfigureDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Configures the data generator for a specific stream.

methods.name: CloseAsync
methods.description: Closes the receiver asynchronously (no-op in this implementation).
